title: Waste Management Service
description: Schema for a Waste Management service record associated with a customer account, covering collection type, materials, equipment, and pricing.

occurrenceFrequency.description: Service pickup frequency (e.g., Weekly, Bi-Weekly, Monthly).

lineOfBusiness.description: Line of business this service belongs to.

material.description: Hauling material details for this service.

materialCode.description: Short code identifying the material type.

materialName.description: Full name of the material (e.g., Municipal Solid Waste).

specialHandling.description: Whether this material requires special handling procedures.

equipment.description: Container and equipment details for this service.

equipmentName.description: Name of the equipment (e.g., 96 Gallon Cart).

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit for the volume (e.g., gallon, cubic yard).

containerCount.description: Number of containers for this service.

monthlyBaseCost.description: Monthly base cost before fees and surcharges.
